evidence.quote: The Baden-Württemberg state government introduced tuition fees of €1500 / semester for non-EU students in Winter Semester 2017/18.

notes: Tuition: the DAAD page also states 'non-EU countries 1,500 EUR' (per semester) and the HFU financing page states 'Non-EU citizens taking a full degree in Baden-Württemberg are required to pay tuition fees.' The semester contribution of €176 applies to all students. Application deadline: the programme page gives '31 August' without a year, and the general application page states 'Application deadline for all bachelor's degree programmes is: Winter Semester: 15 July' (also without a year), so only a recurring deadline (31 August) is recorded. Application channel: no evidence found that uni-assist is required; the Smart Admission page suggests direct email contact with the HFU Business School.
